blurb: Guests fish for tuna, mahi mahi, sailfish, blue marlin, and white marlin aboard a 50-foot custom Carolina boat. The boat is equipped with climate control and multiple fighting chairs for a customizable fishing experience. The crew is experienced and dedicated to providing an enjoyable and educational fishing trip.
